items.title: Define the normative Evidence Environment architecture and ownership boundary
items.context: Establish one source of truth for execution, observation, receipt normalization, admissibility, and gate ownership without creating parallel evidence storage or lifecycle gates.

items.title: Implement the generic Environment Descriptor, Invocation Request, and Receipt contracts
items.context: Extend the existing claim-admissibility/evidence architecture with host-neutral typed identities, execution boundaries, reproducibility and trust metadata while preserving backward compatibility.

items.title: Provide executable and receipt-reading reference adapter paths
items.context: Demonstrate that one contract covers a policy-authorized local-command reference path and the existing Quantum read-receipt-only scientific path. The local path must reuse the existing configured validation executor and must not expose a new arbitrary-command endpoint; actual cwd/path, argv/shell, effective process environment, executable identity, secrets/redaction, network, timeout/cancellation, output bounds, and Evidence Platform storage behavior fail closed under project policy.

items.title: Add fail-closed environment adapter conformance tests
items.context: Mechanically prove descriptor and receipt conformance, deterministic normalization, admissibility-level host substitution, and fail-closed rejection for unknown versions, subject/invocation/environment/executable/shell mismatch, stale or unsafe receipts, checker errors, forbidden execution, secret/network/path policy violations, forged producer identity, quorum substitution, and direct completion authority. Gate-level host substitution is rerun only after M5 integration.

items.title: Publish the paper-facing abstraction and calibrated support claims
items.context: Publish the versioned paper-ready architecture section and claim-to-evidence support matrix in docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-environment-adapter-execution-plan.md, with an explicit external-manuscript handoff requirement and implementation commit/release binding. Wording may advance from Level A to B/C only after CHK-003/004 conformance and M5 Gate evidence; Lean, biology, PINN solver, deployment, and other unimplemented integrations remain future targets.

items.title: Integrate Evidence Environment receipts with Proof Admissibility and lifecycle Gate consumers
items.context: Implement M5 as an explicit owner: normalized EEA receipts enter the shared proof-surface and Proof Admissibility path, diagnostic-only adapters remain non-gating, approved policies may strengthen but never weaken Task/Story/Release requirements, and Gate-level host substitution is verified with fresh evidence while forged or same-producer quorum inputs fail closed.
items.userSees: Registered Evidence Environment receipts can be evaluated by existing Proof Admissibility and lifecycle Gates without giving adapters completion authority.
